64404.description:
Murakami-san, a boss beloved by everyone, and his subordinate Kaji-kun, have a secret. Murakami-san is clingy and easily moved to tears, and she and her subordinate Kaji-kun are lovers. And she has a split tongue.

64419.description:
In the city-state of Orihalconia, where alchemy and magic are deeply woven into everyday life, a reincarnated man named Paracelsus makes a modest living as an alchemist while concealing his powerful cheat skill.

One day, however, he forms a contract with Nora, a sorceress slave girl, and encounters Coco, an elf who has been deprived of her limbs and all of her senses. From that moment, his life begins to change dramatically.

Determined to save Coco, Paracelsus begins a small act of salvation from his humble workshop. But what starts as a personal mission soon grows into a conflict involving alchemy, sorcery, the cosmos, and even the gods themselves—

A story packed with "everything fantasy has to offer" is about to begin!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

64427.description:
BEAT & MOTION is a coming-of-age story about music, animation, and the coming together of creative dreams between Tatsuhiko, a young man who has lost sight of his dream, and Nico, an indie musician who refuses to give up on hers. Though they clash, the two unlock each other’s talent and begin moving toward a creative vision neither could reach alone.

(Source: Netflix)

64428.description:
This is a story about girls that have never left their hometown, and despite the misfortunes they face, continue to say "My hometown is the best!"

(Source: MangaUpdates)

64430.description:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!

Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"

Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

64439.description:
“What you’re about to experience is nothing less than the living history of Rakugo.”

Inspired by her Rakugoka father, Akane Ousaki aims to become a Shin'uchi. After graduating high school, she formally joins Shiguma's school. Now known as Akane Arakawa, she takes her first steps as a Rakugoka. She arrives at Yasaka-tei, a traditional, bustling Rakugo theater. Surrounded by Shin'uchi, Akane finally begins her training at the heart of Rakugo performers. A full-fledged story of Rakugo, where master storytellers compete.

The Zenza Arc begins!

(Source: Akane-banashi Global, edited)

The story tells of how the protagonist, Su Ming, suffers a sudden upheaval in his hometown and embarks on a journey of cultivation, seeking enlightenment and love on a strange continent, fighting against fate in order to find his way home.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

64445.description:
Wang Lin is relentlessly hunted by his sworn enemy in the Thunder Immortal Realm. Pushed to the brink of death, he stages a stunning comeback, overcoming the odds and accomplishing the legendary feat of slaying an Immortal.

(Source: WeTV)

Note: Set between episodes 151 and 152 of Xian Ni.

64446.description:
A group of ordinary people from all walks of life suddenly find themselves in the "Land of Finality." Here, they are trapped in a ten-day cycle of life and death, with their memories wiped clean after every reset. To escape, they must constantly wager their lives in deadly trials hosted by the "Twelve Zodiacs," engaging in psychological warfare and battling both the hosts and their fellow players with strength and wits.
Trapped within this nightmare, Qi Xia is driven by a single obsession: to return to reality and save his wife from imminent danger. As the ten-day cycles repeat, a supernatural power known as "Echo" begins to awaken within certain players. Slowly, Qi Xia and his companions start recovering their sealed memories, uncovering the perilous truth behind this bizarre world and their intertwined fate with the Land of Finality.
Armed with his unparalleled intellect and the diverse "Echo" abilities of his allies, Qi Xia leads his companions to defeat the enemies of the Land of Finality and carve a path back home.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

64451.description:
At the dawn of creation, chaos invades the boundless world, quietly seeding a fragment of its power into every being born within it, waiting to harvest that power once it ripens. To stand against the chaos, Jue Tiantong takes on his first disciple, Xu Yin, a young man he pins his greatest hopes on. But Xu Yin betrays him. Millions of years later, Xu Yang leads the Tianlan Sect. When the Five Thrones revive Xu Yin from his long dormancy, he returns wielding a chaos power far more devastating than before. The war between yin and yang begins.

(Source: WeTV)

Note: Set between Episodes 360 and 361 of Lian Qi Shi Wan Nian.

title.native: 炼气十万年特别篇 阳极天下

64452.description:
It’s a familiar story: a popular high school student gives their plain friend a makeover and transforms their life. But this time, the path to a new life isn’t quite so straight and narrow. Kenshirou Midou has loved cosmetics all his life, keeping his obsession secret from almost everyone except for his childhood friend Hiura Mihate. One day, Kenshirou gets permission to practice applying makeup on Hiura, and the results are earth-shattering: Hiura’s appearance transforms from a plain, undersized boy to a pretty, petite girl, and Kenshirou discovers just how freeing it is to apply his passion! Yet he’s not the only one who finds the process liberating. Hiura likes the makeup, and the subsequent “dress-up” in feminine clothes, and decides to start wearing the girls’ uniform to school. Kenshirou doesn’t understand if he’s unlocked something in Hiura, or if he’s simply seeing a new side to his childhood buddy that he never noticed before. What are these feelings bubbling between them now–is this attraction truly new?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl
I Turned My Childhood Friend (♂) Into a Girl

64459.description:
The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he’s faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself.

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society’s waning humanity.

(Source: VIZ Media)

64466.description:
Meet Juntaro. A Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem:

He has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.

After the hero defeated the demon lord, the world is finally at peace... leaving the young Villager of Beginnerville in a bind! Without a demon lord to defeat, people have no need for potions and items...leaving Villager's item shop, The Nest, empty and lifeless. At this rate, Villager might have to close The Nest...! But then suddenly a mysterious girl appears and everything changes...

64468.description:
Sae, a high school girl who has trouble fitting in at the fancy "ojou-sama" private school, has a daily routine of playing mahjong on an app by herself during lunch break. She was playing in secret, thinking that such a hobby is unfashionable...? But one day, Chisei, the most popular girl in class, finds out about it! The two girls with opposite personalities, who normally wouldn't have anything in common, become playmates through mahjong...?
